title: Liquid federation

schema.script: m-of-n CHECKMULTISIG IFDUP NOTIF <t> CSV VERIFY m2-of-n2 CHECKMULTISIG ENDIF

note: The check matches m, compressed keys, n, CHECKMULTISIG, IFDUP NOTIF, a small delay, CSV, VERIFY, a second compressed multisig, ENDIF. m is at most n, and n is at most 16. It clears the fake-multisig mark on that whole script. It does not copy Knots' rule that skips charging the keys on the signed path. Not an insert package.
